levels.lenient: Sensitivity: LENIENT. Only report clear, serious {noun} you are highly confident about; when in doubt, leave it out. Report at most 3.
levels.balanced: Sensitivity: BALANCED. Report {noun} that genuinely matter and skip borderline cases. Report at most 5.
levels.strict: Sensitivity: STRICT. Also surface subtler or lower-confidence {noun}, marking uncertain ones as low confidence. Report at most 7.
